article.title: Conector a fim de que
article.part: Adverbios, conjunciones y conectores — Advérbios, conjunções e conectores
article.chapter: Conjunciones, conectores y relaciones lógicas — Conjunções, conectores e relações lógicas

claims.summary: The phrase 'a fim de que' is used to introduce the purpose or objective of the main action.

claims.sectionKey: Su significado se aproxima ao de 'para que'
claims.summary: The phrase 'a fim de que' is similar to 'para que' in meaning but is more frequently used in formal, administrative, academic, or written registers.

claims.sectionKey: El resultado se apresenta como buscado ou previsto
claims.summary: The result presented by the phrase 'a fim de que' is sought or expected, not an independently affirmed fact.

links.notes: The source from Ciberdúvidas da Língua Portuguesa provides a clear definition and examples of the usage of 'a fim de que' in formal, administrative, academic, or written contexts, supporting the normative claim.

The source from Ciberdúvidas da Língua Portuguesa explains the similarity between 'a fim de que' and 'para que', and highlights the difference in frequency of usage in different registers, supporting the orthography claim.
The source from Ciberdúvidas da Língua Portuguesa illustrates the usage of 'a fim de que' in sentences where the result is sought or expected, supporting the historical claim.
